env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A wrapped interpolated call lowered inside a const for copy must nest
# inside its MustNonNil wrapper in eject instead of aborting with
# overlapping edits. The wrapper and the interpolation both target the
# same unrolled copy, so their buffer offsets share one region while
# their origin chunks share the original offsets; the fold maps through
# buffer placement. The plain wrapped call is the control that already
# nested.

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^control plain$'
stdout '^fallback Name$'
stdout '^fallback Count$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..
cd b
logos run .
stdout '^fallback Name Name$'
stdout '^fallback Count Count$'
cp stdout $WORK/b-native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/b-native-stdout.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectcfwrap

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type Row struct {
	Name string
	Count int
}

func showReader(r *strings.Reader, tag string) {
	var sb strings.Builder
	if _, err := r.WriteTo(&sb); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(sb.String(), tag)
}

func plain() *strings.Reader {
	return strings.NewReader($"control")
}

func main() {
	showReader(plain(), "plain")
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		var r *strings.Reader = strings.NewReader($"fallback")
		showReader(r, f.Name)
	}
}

-- b/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectcfwrapb

go 1.27

-- b/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type Row struct {
	Name string
	Count int
}

func showReader(r *strings.Reader, tag string) {
	var sb strings.Builder
	if _, err := r.WriteTo(&sb); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(sb.String(), tag)
}

func main() {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		var r *strings.Reader = strings.NewReader($"fallback {f.Name}")
		showReader(r, f.Name)
	}
}
